motion.name: caret-blink
motion.purpose: Terminal caret only; equalizer movement obeys prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: preview-video-playback
motion.purpose: Muted preview videos play only while their frame is visible; reduced motion keeps the poster image.

components.name: Active language pill
components.description: Current locale in the status bar.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-block; padding:3px 7px; font:700 12px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; border-radius:0; } .ds-pill--on { background:#A8E05B; color:#0A0C0A; }

components.name: Passive language pill
components.description: Available locale in the status bar.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-block; padding:3px 7px; font:400 12px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; border-radius:0; } .ds-pill--off { border:1px solid #2A322A; color:#93A08F; } .ds-pill--off:hover { color:#C4EC8A; }

components.name: Preview media frame
components.description: A 319:180 project frame where the static screenshot hands off to a muted video loop after the first decoded frame.
components.css: .ds-preview-media { aspect-ratio:319/180; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #2A322A; background:#0A0C0A; } .ds-preview-media img { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; }

components.name: Music tuner
components.description: A compact fixed lower-right equalizer control with reactive frequency feedback and audio toggle.
components.css: .audio-control { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; border:1px solid #2A322A; border-radius:0; background:#0B0E0B; color:#7E8B7B; }

narrative.overview: A dark, terminal-inspired portfolio where the work remains primary and the interface reads as a precise working environment. Lime is a rare signal colour, never a broad decorative surface; its job is to show an active choice, a focused action, or a live status.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, monochrome surfaces with hairline structural borders.
One monospaced voice, tuned for dense project metadata rather than technical costume.
Sparse lime signals for state, focus, and action.
A static vertical grid and editorial rail create the page rhythm.

rules.name: Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime represents a state or action. It must not become a large decorative fill or a second background.

rules.name: Single Voice Rule
rules.body: New interface elements inherit the mono system; hierarchy comes from size, weight, and colour roles, not a new type family.

dos: Use existing CSS colour roles and JetBrains Mono for every new portfolio control.
Make interaction state explicit through lime, labels, focus rings, and semantic HTML.
Preserve the status bar's compact information rhythm on both breakpoints.
Honour reduced-motion preferences by retaining readable static states.
Keep a static project screenshot visible until optional preview media is ready.
donts: Do not add rounded cards, gradients, glass decoration, or a new colour family.
Do not make the equalizer decorative only.
Do not use lime as a broad surface outside a meaningful active state.
